# Vocals (usevocals.com)

> Vocals is an AI voice agent that turns a company's technical knowledge into instant phone support for its field technicians, and every repair into information that helps prevent the next breakdown. Vocals is made by Usevocals LLC.

## Who it is for
Field service and maintenance companies: elevators, vending machines, cranes, mining and quarries, production lines, HVAC and refrigeration.

## What technicians can do
Field technicians talk directly to the voice agent, which helps them diagnose and fix breakdowns in real time, while they work. They can:
- Get instant answers from technical manuals, without searching through hundreds of pages
- Check the repair history to see how similar issues were solved
- Follow step-by-step diagnostics adapted to the equipment and the fault
- Log every intervention by voice: the fault, the diagnosis, the actions taken and the fix

## How it helps get ahead of breakdowns
- Every repair builds the history of each machine: what failed, why and how it was fixed
- That history makes recurring faults and early warning signs visible across equipment
- It helps identify the machines most likely to fail again, so preventive visits can be planned
- Service managers can plan maintenance ahead instead of reacting to emergencies

## What makes it different
- It answers only from what the company provides: manuals, procedures, service history and its senior technicians' know-how. It cites where each step comes from.
- It listens to the technician and reads the machine: where the company has telemetry, it shows what the technician can't see, and the technician reports what no sensor measures.
- Safety: it never explains how to disable a safety device. If a fault involves a safety device, it hands the call to a person.
- It doesn't replace senior technicians on complex cases. It stops every fault from ending up on their phone.
- It writes each job as a service report in the company's CRM, ERP or SAP.
- Technicians use an ordinary phone call, at any hour and in any language.

## Results for field service companies
Less time searching for answers, a clearer view of every machine and technical know-how that stays inside the organisation.

## Key facts
- 1M+ calls handled
- Under 30 days to full integration
